name: Hang Time
text: Every 20 s a trampoline lands beside him and waits 30 s. Run onto it: he soars 8 m the way he was running, untouchable in the air, and the stick steers him a little.
art_prompt: a round backyard trampoline with a black mat stretched tight and a thick blue padded rim on short steel legs, seen from a three-quarter view above
